plan.title: Adipose treated vs control DE adjusted for sex/age
plan.analytical_narrative: This is a 6-vs-6 unpaired bulk RNA-seq contrast (adipose, treated vs control) from raw Salmon-derived gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples), with sex (F/M) and age (years, unmatched between groups) recorded per sample. Because age is not balanced across groups, an unadjusted two-group test would let age confound the condition effect; the design therefore includes both sex and mean-centered age as fixed-effect covariates in the DESeq2 GLM rather than removing their effect from the counts first (which would bias the SEs). Track 1 runs sample-structure QC (to confirm no gross outlier or age/sex-driven separation dominates PC1), then the DESeq2 Wald test with a minimal low-count pre-filter, median-of-ratios normalization, apeglm shrinkage of the condition coefficient, and BH-adjusted independent filtering at alpha 0.05. An edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same design is run in parallel as a robustness check (per the grounded rule for 2-11 replicates/group), and the two gene lists are intersected. Track 2 takes the DESeq2 Wald statistic ranking into fgsea preranked GSEA against MSigDB Hallmark (primary) and Reactome (secondary, gene-set collection staged locally) for human. A final report step consolidates DE results, robustness overlap, enrichment, and reproducibility metadata. No batch structure is present, and there is no reference cohort or public dataset needed since this is a straightforward two-group design with covariates the DESeq2 GLM can handle directly.

design = ~ sex + age_centered + condition, explicit reference level (control)
apeglm shrinkage on the condition coefficient
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome
DE + enrichment report with diagnostics, session info, reproducibility record
